title: PNP checking reports on 1,500 Filipinos trapped in Myanmar scam hubs

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police is stepping up cross-border coordination with foreign law enforcement agencies to track down and rescue up to 1,500 Filipinos allegedly being held against their will in Myanmar-based online scam hubs. “We are verifying this report in coordination with other government agencies,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.
